$comment: Language models the app can run in the browser. scripts/download-model.mjs downloads them into public/models and copies these settings into public/models/manifest.json, which src/llm/worker.ts reads. 'small' runs on every device (Qwen3.5-0.8B was dropped: about 10× slower in the browser, with no better answers). chatTemplate: variables for the chat template (thinking stays off for option picking). thinking: reason before free-form answers, hidden from the user, at most thinkingBudget tokens. generation: overrides of src/llm/config.ts GENERATION for free-form answers.
